purpose: Complete structurally invalid first-pass grading records without replacing or concealing their original verdicts or validation failures.
reason: Early Claude responses supplied empty source_evidence arrays for decided criteria. The validator requires evidence for each decided criterion; the original prompt did not state the nonempty-array rule as explicitly as the validator. This is a post-hoc response to observed grader behavior.
priority: All 80 original Gemini and Claude first-pass cells must have a terminal physical attempt before any repair call.
selection: All first-pass invalid_judgment records with a parsed assessment and contract_valid=false validation. Do not select by substantive verdict or human agreement.
transport: evaluation_v5_rejection_budget.make_client: versioned Python HTTP transport and reviewed provider-rejection reconciliation, preserving the shared USD30 ledger and all ambiguous-charge reservations; implementation and both reconciliation amendments frozen before completion calls.
inputs: Same judge and saved original message history, including evidence already supplied and its own initial response; append exact structural errors and explicit citation/coverage requirements. No other judge or human labels.
allowed_changes: Return a complete assessment. Add source quotations only when present in the supplied evidence. If support or inspection is insufficient, report uncertainty. Record every changed verdict, severity, class or coverage field separately.
forbidden_claims: rubric accuracy established by schema completion
analysis: First-pass validity and comparisons remain primary. Repair validity, additional costs and all outcome changes form a separately labeled secondary analysis. Never overwrite original response, assessment, validation, history or result.
